decision.reason: [ev-5125d54a5bab] is a one-line highlight that only says the `RetryOnFailure` lifecycle management strategy is introduced for HelmRelease. It does not say whether the strategy is opt-in or becomes the default, or whether existing HelmReleases are affected. So the proposed claim that it "does not affect existing HelmRelease configurations" goes beyond what the evidence states. To settle the consequence, we need the HelmRelease API docs or changelog entry that names the field selecting the strategy and gives its default.
